title: The Feast of the Migrating Mosaic
description: At the last feast of spring, glass tiles lift from the courtyard floor and fly away as herons. A bird-shaped gap stays empty until they return.
alt: Herons made of pink and blue-green mosaic tiles fly toward a stone arch, leaving a bird-shaped gap beside the courtyard feast tables.
pairing: A late-spring feast × a mosaic that migrates
